period_note: Sourced from the bank's own full unaudited interim financial statements PDF ('First Quarter Un-Audited Financial Statements 31 March 2026'), a genuine 24-page scanned document containing full Consolidated AND separate/Solo Balance Sheet, Profit and Loss Account, Off-balance Sheet Items, Cash Flow Statement, Statement of Changes in Equity, and 45 numbered notes -- a materially richer source than the compact single-page 'Evaluation of Quarterly Financials' table used for this bank's prior interim quarters (e.g. 2025_Q3.json). BASIS: SOLO/SEPARATE, taken from the pages explicitly headed 'Shahjalal Islami Bank PLC.' (distinct from the 'Shahjalal Islami Bank PLC. and its Subsidiary' Consolidated pages earlier in the same PDF) -- consistent with this bank's established all-Solo convention across its full 15-year annual series and its 2015-2025 interim series (see sources.json). Verified: this Solo Balance Sheet's own 31-Dec-2025 comparative column (Total Property and Assets 427,425,708,361) reproduces the dataset's already-validated quarterly/2025_Q4.json Solo figure (427,425.71m) to the taka. EXTRACTION METHOD: the PDF is a scanner output (0 lines extracted by pdftotext -layout on every page) -- all figures below were read directly from 300dpi page renders of the Solo Balance Sheet (p.6), Solo Off-balance Sheet Items (p.7), and Solo Profit and Loss Account (p.8), not run through OCR software, since a direct visual read of clean typeset scanned tables is more reliable than tesseract for this document; every figure was independently cross-checked against the document's own internal arithmetic (see below), not against a second source. Income-statement items are CUMULATIVE from 1 January 2026 (column header 'Jan'26 to Mar'26'); for Q1 this is identical to the discrete quarter, consistent with this bank's established _cumulative-suffix convention (e.g. 2025_Q3.json). VALIDATED: Total Liabilities 402,766,576,452 + Total Shareholders' Equity 26,775,472,958 = Total Property and Assets 429,542,049,410 (exact, balance-sheet identity holds to the taka); Total Operating Income 5,647,418,528 - Total Operating Expenses 1,631,210,899 = Profit before Provision 4,016,207,629 (exact); Profit before Provision - Total Provision 1,112,630,101 = Total Profit before Taxes 2,903,577,528 (exact); Total Profit before Taxes - Tax 1,641,303,344 = Net Profit after Taxation 1,262,274,184 (exact, matches reported PAT to the taka). No classified-investment/NPL breakdown or Capital Adequacy (CRAR) disclosure is present anywhere in this 24-page interim filing (confirmed by reading through to the final note, no. 45) -- this is a genuine feature of the filing itself (Bangladesh Bank does not require the full Basel/Pillar-3 asset-quality disclosure in an unaudited quarterly filing), not a research gap, so npl_pct/car_pct/classified_investments are simply not populated for this quarter, consistent with the same gap in this bank's own prior interim quarterly files.
